title: Lyophilized Plant Extraction for LC-MS Analysis
author: Kateřina Kučerová

steps.title: Prepare Plant Material
steps.instruction: Weight 25 ± 2.5 mg of lyophilized plant material into a 2.0 Eppendorf tube with round bottom and add a metal bead.

steps.title: Extract Plant Material
steps.instruction: Add 2 000 μL of EtOH-H2O (75:25) to the tube and mix via vortex.

steps.title: Incubate and Centrifuge
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture at 40 °C for 3 min, then centrifuge for 5 min at 14 000 rpm.

steps.title: Isolate and Dry Supernatant
steps.instruction: Transfer 500 μL of the supernatant into a new 2.0 Eppendorf tube and dry using a SpeedVac.

steps.title: Resuspend Sample
steps.instruction: Resuspend the dried material in 2 000 μL of H2O-CH3CN (50:50).

steps.title: Homogenize and Clarify
steps.instruction: Sonicate the sample for 15 sec, vortex for 30 sec, and centrifuge for 5 min at 14 000 rpm.

steps.title: Transfer to Vials
steps.instruction: Transfer the resulting supernatant into LC-MS vials.
